meta.description: A full Home Assistant backup every night and again after a start when the newest one is too old, a retention that keeps the newest few plus one per recent week, sensors for the newest backup's age, the number of backups and the folder's size, and a notification when backups stop.

status.title: Backup status
status.description: Report archive count, newest age and folder size; existence does not prove restoration.
examples: How old is the latest backup?

explain.title: About backups
explain.description: Backup keeps local archives and reports their presence, not restoreability or an off-site copy.
